name: Asset World Corp Public Company Limited
summary: Asset World Corp Public Company Limited develops and invests in real estate properties in Thailand. The company operates through two segments, Retail, Wholesale and Commercial; and Hospitality. It owns and develops a portfolio of hotels, retail and office buildings, and integrated mixed-use properties. The company also engages in commercial building rendering and rental services. Asset World Corp Public Company Limited was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
